Ecásse is a clove gathered from the heaths, scrublands and moors of mild temperate northern Endor. It remains very difficult to find even in favourable terrain.

Prepared as an infusion or decoction, it acts as a powerful hallucinogenic stimulant. It temporarily protects against certain mental attacks and illnesses, but also produces delusional trust towards anyone the user sees. A long and painful after-effect follows. Repeated doses carry a significant risk of dependence.
